'''Lancer armor''' was the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn by members of the [[Velabri Lancers]]. The armor was mainly an ash-colored chestpiece, and helped to protect the wearer from both physical and energy weapons.<ref name="SF">{{JournalCite|12|Small Favors}}</ref>
